Source: A comprehensive study about the spread of COVID-19 cases in Turkey and South Africa has been presented in this paper.

Source: An exhaustive statistical analysis was performed using data collected from Turkey and South Africa within the period of 11 March 2020 to 3 May 2020 and 05 March and 3 of May, respectively.
Luganda: Okwekenneenya ebibalo okujjuvu kwakolebwa nga bakozesa ebyekenneenyezebwa ebyakuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva mu Turkey ne South Africa mu kiseera 11 Ogwokusatu 2020 okutuuka nga 3 Ogwokutaano 2020 ne 05 Ogwokusatu ne 3 Ogwokutaano, mu busengeke obwo.

Zulu: Isihlaziyo esibheka konke sezinombolo senziwa kwesetshenziswa imininingo eqoqwe eThekhi naseNingizimu Afrika esikhathini 11 kuNdasa 2020 kuya ku-3 kuNhlaba 2020 kanye no-05 kuNdasa no-3 kuNhlaba, ngokulandelana.
Hausa: An gudanar da cikakken bincike na ƙididdiga ta amfani da bayanan da aka tattara daga Turkiyya da kuma Afirka ta Kudu a tsakanin 11 ga watan Maris 2020 zuwa 3 ga watan Mayu 2020 da 05 Maris da 3 ga watan Mayu, bi da bi.

Yoruba: Wọn ṣe àgbàsílẹ̀ dátà iye ìrànmọ́-ra-ẹni ojoojúmọ́, àwọn tí ó ti kú àti àwọn tí ara wọn ti yá láti South Africa àti Turkey láti ìgbà tí àrùn ìrànmọ́ra-ẹni yìí ti kọ́kọ́ yọjú títí di 3 May 2020.
Zulu: Babeqoqa ukutheleleka, ukufa nokusinda kwansukuzonke eNingizimu Afrika naseThekhi kusukela esiqitshwini sokuqala kuya ku-3 kuNhlaba 2020.

Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba kgoboketša tshedimošo ka ga diphetetšo tša ka mehla, tša mahu le go fola ga balwetši go tšwa ka Afrika Borwa le Turkey go thoma ka lnako ya tlhatlogo ya mathomo ya diphetetšo go fihla ka la 3 Mei 2020.
Amharic: የመጀመሪያዎቹ የኢንፌክሽን ሞገዶች ከጀመሩበት ከሜይ 3፣2020 ጀምሮ እለታዊ የኢንፌክሽን፣ የሞት እና ያገገሙ ሰዎች መረጃን ከደቡብ አፍሪካ እና ከቱርክ ሰብስበዋል፡፡

Source: They then created multiple possible models of how COVID-19 spreads.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma bassaawo emitetenkanyirizo egiwera egiyinza okunnyonnyola engeri COVID-19 gy’asaasaanamu.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn náa, wọn ṣe àgbékalẹ̀ onírúurú àwòṣe lórí bí COVID-19 ṣe ń gbòòrò.
Zulu: Babe sebesungula amamodeli amabalwa okungaba yiwo okuthi i-COVID-19 isabalala kanjani.
Hausa: Sannan sun ƙirƙiri samfuran yiwuwar yadda cutar COVID-19 take yaɗuwa.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao ba ile ba hlama mekgwa ya mentši ye e kgonagalago mabapi le ka fao COVID-19 e phatlalalago ka gona.

Source: Importantly, they made a model of how it may spread with a lockdown in place and another without a lockdown.
Luganda: Ekisinga obukulu, bakola omutetenkanyirizo ogw’engeri gy’ayinza okusaasaanamu nga waliwo omuggalo n’omutetenkanyirizo omulala nga tewali muggalo.
Yoruba: Ní pàtàkì, wọn ṣe àwòṣe bí ó ti ṣe é ṣe kí ó ràn pẹ̀lú ìsémọ́lé ní àwọn ibì kan, àti ní àwọn ibi tí kò ti sí ìsémọ́lé.
Zulu: Okubalulekile, benza imodeli yokuthi lungasabala kanjani kunokuvalwa kwezwe kwenye indawo lingavaliwe kwenye.

Northern Sotho: Se bohlokwa ke gore, ba dirile mokgwa wa ka fao e ka phatlalalago ka gona ge magato a kiletšo ya mesepelo a dirilwe le a mangwe ka ntle le kiletšo ya mesepelo.
Amharic: በተለይም የእንቅስቃሴ እገዳ ሲኖር እና የእንቅስቃሴ እገዳ ሳይኖር በሽታው እንዴት እንደሚስፋፋ የሚያሳዩ ሞዴሎችን ሰርተዋል፡፡

Source: Their model predicted that COVID-19 would infect a whole country in about 2 months without a lockdown, and about 25% of people would not survive.
Luganda: Omutetenkanyirizo gwabwe gwateebereza nti COVID-19 yandikutte eggwanga lyonna mu myezi nga 2 nga tewali muggalo, era ng’abantu ebitundu nga 25% tebandiwonye.
Yoruba: Àwòṣe wọn sọ tẹ́lẹ̀ pé COVID-19 máa ran gbogbo orilẹ̀ èdè ní àárín oṣù 2 láì sí ìsémọ́lé, àti pé ìdá 25% àwọn ènìyàn ni kò ní yè é.
Zulu: Imodeli yabo yaqagula ukuthi i-COVID-19ingaphatha izwe lonke esikhathini esingangezinyanga ezi-2 ngaphandle kokuvalwa thaqa kwezwe, kanti cishe abantu abanga-25% bengangasinda.
Hausa: Tsarinsu ya yi hasashen cewa cutar COVID-19 za ta kama wata ƙasa gabaɗaya a cikin kusan watanni 2 ba tare da kulle ba, kuma kusan kashi 25% na mutane ba za su tsira ba.
Northern Sotho: Mokgwa wa bona o akantše gore COVID-19 e ka fetela batho ba naga ka moka mo dikgweding tše 2 ka ntle le kiletšo ya mesepelo, gomme tekano ya 25% ya batho e ka se phologe.
Amharic: ሞዴላቸው፣ ያለምንም እንቅስቃሴ እገዳ ኮቪድ-19 ሙሉ ሃገረን ለመውረር 2 ወር እንደሚፈጅበት የተነበየ ሲሆን፣ 25% ያህል ሰዎች ከበሽታው እንደማይድኑ አሳይቷል፡፡

Source: On the other hand, if everyone followed lockdown rules, cases may drop by 90% in 2 weeks.
Luganda: Ku ludda olulala, singa buli muntu agoberera amateeka g’omuggalo, abalwala bayinza okukendeera n’ebitundu 90% mu wiiki 2.

Zulu: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma wonke umuntu elalndela imithetho yokuvalwa thaqa kwezwe, izigameko zingehla ngama-90% emavikini ama-2.

Source: The researchers found that actions by individuals, such as social distancing, regular hand-washing, and wearing masks, are essential to limit the spread of COVID-19.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakizuula nti ebikolwa by’abantu, ng’okwewa amabanga, okunaaba mu ngalo, n’okwambala obukookolo, bikulu nnyo mu kukendeeza okusaasaana kwa COVID-19.
Yoruba: ̀Àwọn olùwádìí ṣe àwárí pé ìsesí olúkúlùkù, bíi ìjìnà sí ara ẹni ní àwùjọ, fífọ ọwọ́ lóòrè-kóòrè, àti wíwọ ìbòmú, jẹ́ àwọn ohun pàtàkì láti dènà ìtànkálẹ̀ àrùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi ukwenza kwabantu okufana nokuqhela kwabanye, ukuvama ukuhlamba izandla kanye nokufaka izifonyo, kubalulekile ukunqanda ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19.

Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba utollotše gore ditiro tša batho, tša go swana le go tlogela sekgoba magareng ga batho, go hlapa diatla kgafetšakgafetša, le go apara dimaseke, di bohlokwa go fokotša go phatlalala ga COVID-19.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች በግለሰብ ደረጃ የሚወሰዱ እንደ እየደጋገሙ እጅን መታጠብ እና የፊት ጭምብሎችን ማድረግ አይነት እርምጃዎች የኮቪድ-19 መስፋፋትን ለመገደብ አስፈላጊ ናቸው፡፡

Source: Their models also predicted that government actions, such as banning alcohol sales and public smoking, are also useful.
Luganda: Emitetenkanyirizo gyabwe era gyateebereza nti ebikolwa bya gavumenti, ng’okuwera okutunda omwenge n’okunywera sigala mu bantu, nabyo bya mugaso.

Zulu: Amamodeli abo aphinde aqagula ukuthi izenzo zikahulumeni, ezifana nokuval ukudayiswa kotshwala nokubhema ngaphandle kuyasebenza nakho.

Northern Sotho: Mekgwa ya bona e akantše gape gore magato ao a tšewago ke mmušo, a go swana le go iletša go rekišwa ga bjala le go kgoga phatlalatša, le ona a mohola.
Amharic: ሞዴሎቻቸው በተጨማሪ፣ የአልኮል ሽያጭን እና ህዝብ በተሰበሰበበት ቦታ ማጨስን መከልከል አይነት እርምጃዎች ጠቃሚ እንደሆኑ ይተነብያሉ፡፡

Zulu: Abacwaningi nokho baxwayisa ukuthi abakwazanga ukuqinisekisa okunye ukucabangela kwamamodeli abo, okusho ukuthi amamodeli abo kungenzeka enganembi uma eqhatahniswa nomhlaba wangempela.

Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale banyakišiši ba ile ba lemoša gore ba ka se tiišetše dikakanyo tše dingwe tša mekgwa ya bona, go era gore mekgwa ya bona e ka no se nepagale ge e bapetšwa le lefase la mmakgonthe.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ተመራማሪዎቹ አንዳንዶቹን የሞዴሎቻቸውን ግምቶች ማረጋገጥ ስላልቻሉ ሞዴሎቹ ከገሃዱ አለም ጋር ሲነጻጻሩ ትክክለኛ ላይሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ያስጠነቅቃሉ፡፡

Source: They also did not explain what exactly caused the significant difference between South Africa and Turkey.

Source: Researchers from South Africa, Turkey, and Taiwan worked together on this study.
